metadata.title: बाघ के लिए आदिवासी जंगल से बेदखल | Tribal displacement in Satkosia Tiger Reserve
metadata.description: Concerns have resurfaced regarding the displacement of tribal communities from Odisha's Satkosia Tiger Reserve. Despite the reserve lacking a tiger population, authorities have relocated approximately 78 families, leading to significant hardship for the affected communities. Critics argue that displacing Indigenous people for tiger conservation is unjustified, especially in reserves without tigers. This situation reflects a broader national issue, with reports indicating that Project Tiger may displace up to 550,000 tribals and forest dwellers across India.  Advocates emphasise the need for conservation strategies that respect the rights and livelihoods of indigenous communities.
